name: Ranking adjudicator
design: Gaunt old male with ivory-grey reptilian skin, pronounced narrow brow, four curved mandibular tusks, long sparse white dreadlocks. Straight black official robes with a single wide diagonal ochre sash from shoulder to hip, small bronze clasps, narrow waist cord and sandals-like ankle straps leaving claws visible. Carries three small ranking cylinders in a holder on belt, both hands lightly clasped at lower chest. Reserved authority.
